== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Destruction]] that deals [[armor-ignoring damage|armor-ignoring]] [[lightning damage|lightning]] damage.
* Combine this with [[Ritual Lord]] or [[Soul Twisting]] for faster [[recharge]] and damage output.
* Use with skills that [[:Category:Spirit removing skills|destroy spirits]] to control the damage [[spike]], such as [[Rupture Soul]].
